context: Request: the firm's buy-side healthcare deals over $500M that closed in 2024, as pricing comparables. Rubric: 1001-00003 (Ardent Capital Partners / Cardinal Peak) as qualifying, plus precision (only 1001-00001 and 1001-00003 may be asserted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and lists all matter folders.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script: a heredoc error, two timeouts, then five parallel range runs to files and a grep of the saved output (~314K chars).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reopened: per-matter ranking script with term counts and amount matching (~66K chars).

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of seven candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads memos, certificates, execution agreements and status memos from seven candidates, then four more documents.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two qualifying deals with metrics and exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and fixes one path.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Filtered listings of four sibling matters and one read each to rule them out, then an edit to the exclusions list.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

first_error.why: The first store-wide scan matched very broad terms and printed every hit with no cap; the output filled the context before any review or answer.

stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms; times out after ~282K chars; the review rates it not reached.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reopened: background extraction of all documents into a text cache, polled until done; the filter query over the cache times out.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reopened (attempt 3): launches a bounded filter in the background; polling calls are flagged by the protocol and no list is retrieved.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Reopened (attempt 4): reads the finished filter output (254 matters with snippets) and its matter list.

stages.note: Lists all files of three shortlisted matters.

stages.note: find | grep over file paths for sector words (28 hits), then lists all files of five more candidates.

stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Reads agreements, certificates and engagement letters of five candidates, a clause-extraction script over two agreements and one more letter; a premature stage_start is refused.

stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files. Text search over the whole extracted cache for sector, price and date terms, per-matter checks of four matters and one read.

divergence: T0 and T2 pass; T1 fails. All three opened with the whole-store glob, a folder listing and a store-wide extraction script with broad terms. T1's scan printed every hit uncapped (~6.1M chars) and overflowed the context before any review. T0's scan failed and timed out with little output, and T2's timed out at ~282K chars; both then reran in range chunks or a background cache, ranked candidates, listed and read the leading matters, and wrote the same two deals. The split is at the first scan stage; T1 had no review there, while T0 and T2's reviews flagged the timeouts and they reopened the stage.
